scope.purpose: Define a read-only interface for aligning and comparing native HDF5 or CSV particle trajectories without a model, optimizer, checkpoint, solver, or GPU.
scope.scientific_acceptance_reason: A numerical reference trajectory or a D03 internal mechanism card does not constitute an external measurement or independently authenticated ground truth.
allowed_operations: read HDF5 trajectory datasets and metadata
read DualSPHysics PartVTK frame CSV files or long-form trajectory CSV
align common identities and saved times
compute native trajectory observables and reference-agreement diagnostics
run synthetic/unit tests in a temporary directory
forbidden_operations: DualSPHysics, GenCase, PartVTK, or solver launch
writing benchmark artifacts unless an explicit caller output path is supplied

adopted_contracts: read-only inspection and verification are distinct from learning phases
registered time axes are explicit and missing frames are not silently removed
particle identity and valid lifecycle state are part of the trajectory contract
source inspection does not imply scientific qualification
SI-valued time, position, velocity, density, pressure, mass, type, and mk fields when present
explicit valid[T,N] mask; invalid values are never interpreted as physical zero
open lifecycle and numerical loss remain observable rather than normalized away

d03_reference_cards.scope_effect: A card with diagnostic_open_lifecycle selects open-lifecycle reporting; exclude_from_core and calibration_only remain diagnostic labels. The card never upgrades scientific acceptance.

source_forms: directory containing PartVTK frame CSV files named Particles_*.csv
directory or file containing long-form trajectory CSV with time and particle identity columns

required_datasets.particle_zone: [N] integer zone axis; zero is allowed

hdf5.identity: Use (particle_zone, particle_id) internally even when identity_key declares particle_id; duplicate tuples are invalid.
hdf5.invalid_payload: Values under valid=false may be NaN or fill values and are ignored. Values under valid=true must be finite for required numeric fields.

partvtk_frame.layout: three-line header followed by particle rows
partvtk_frame.time: first numeric value on the summary row before the particle header

long_form.accepted_aliases: The evaluator accepts the equivalent PartVTK names and common snake_case names.
long_form.grouping: Rows are grouped by finite time; identity rows may be absent at a frame and become valid=false.

csv.time_axis: All parsed CSV frames are sorted by time only after checking that times are finite and unique; the resulting axis must be strictly increasing.

metadata.missing_protocol_attributes: Reported as metadata warnings; they do not change a trajectory into scientific ground truth.
metadata.case_id: Read from HDF5 case_id when present; otherwise source stem.
metadata.family: Read from HDF5 family or D03 card when present; otherwise null.

identity.operation: Set intersection; report reference-only and candidate-only identities separately.
identity.no_set_matching: Spatial proximity or unordered point-set matching cannot create identity matches.

time.operation: One-to-one nearest saved-time matching within an absolute tolerance.
time.dropped_frames: Explicitly reported on both sides; no denominator is silently shrunk after an unmatched frame.

lifecycle.invalid_values: Never scored, imputed, or interpreted as zero.
lifecycle.open_lifecycle: Reference-only, candidate-only, common-active, active-count, active-mass, and mask-disagreement summaries are reported separately.
lifecycle.closed_lifecycle: A caller may require identical complete masks, but the default evaluator remains diagnostic and still reports the intersection if masks differ.
lifecycle.mass_policy: Use native mass values on active identities; do not renormalize surviving mass to one.

native_observables.principle: Observables are derived only from fields present in the native trajectory; absence is null/diagnostic rather than fabricated.

centroid.aggregation: mass-weighted centroid; arithmetic fallback is disclosed

native_observables.comparison: For aligned frames, emit per-observable count, MAE, RMSE, maximum absolute error, and per-frame values. These are reference-agreement diagnostics, not scientific acceptance.

metrics.normalization: position_rmse_over_dp is emitted only when dp is explicitly supplied; no inferred dp is used.
metrics.native_observable_agreement: Per-observable scalar/vector error summaries from the registry.

score_interface.missingness: A metric with no comparable finite samples is null with status insufficient_common_active; it is not zero.

required_external_inputs_for_future_asse: independent measurement or authenticated external ground truth

commands.score: score --reference PATH --candidate PATH [--time-tolerance-s FLOAT] [--dp FLOAT] [--reference-cards PATH]

cli.stdout: JSON metadata or diagnostic result; errors are nonzero and written to stderr.
cli.default_write_behavior: No repository output is written. An explicit caller-owned output option may be added later without changing the read/align/score semantics.

synthetic_assertions: cross-format HDF5 reference and PartVTK CSV candidate load successfully
common identity and one-to-one time alignment are explicit
open lifecycle masks exclude invalid payloads and expose mask disagreement
native observables are present when source fields are present
scientific_acceptance.status remains not_assessed without external ground truth
no solver, GPU, training, inference, or checkpoint path is called
